mapper.select: SELECT member_id, password, type_cd, nickname, handle, profile_file_id, gender_cd, status_cd, use_yn, password_expire_dt, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(name,'HEX'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS member_name, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(phone,'HEX'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS phone, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(email,'HEX'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS email, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(birth,'HEX'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS birth, CASE WHEN password_expire_dt IS NOT NULL AND password_expire_dt < NOW() THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS pw_expired, CASE WHEN password_expire_dt IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(0, CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (password_expire_dt - NOW())) / 86400)::int) END AS pw_days_left, CASE WHEN status_cd = 'STATUS02' AND lock_until_dt IS NOT NULL AND lock_until_dt + ((SELECT fail_lock_mins FROM config LIMIT 1) || ' minutes')::interval > NOW() THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS lock_active, fail_cnt, token_ver, (SELECT fail_cnt_limit FROM config LIMIT 1) AS fail_cnt_limit, (SELECT fail_lock_mins FROM config LIMIT 1) AS fail_lock_mins, CASE WHEN status_cd = 'STATUS02' AND lock_until_dt IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(1, CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lock_until_dt + ((SELECT fail_lock_mins FROM config LIMIT 1) || ' minutes')::interval - NOW())) / 60)::int) ELSE NULL END AS lock_remain_min FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND nickname = #{nickname}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND nickname = #{nickname} AND member_id <> #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET token_ver = token_ver + 1 WHERE member_id = #{memberId} RETURNING token_ver

SELECT member_id AS row_id, member_id, type_cd, nickname, gender_cd, status_cd, use_yn, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(name,'HEX'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS member_name, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(phone,'HEX'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS phone, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(email,'HEX'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS email, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(birth,'HEX'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS birth, -- 어뷰징 판단 참고치(팔로워가 비정상적으로 많은 계정 등). 목록이 아닌 상세에서만 계산한다 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_follow f WHERE f.followee_id = member.member_id)::TEXT AS follower_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_follow f WHERE f.member_id = member.member_id)::TEXT AS following_cnt FROM member WHERE member_id = #{rowId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( member_id, password, type_cd, name, nickname, phone, email, gender_cd, birth, status_cd, use_yn, fail_cnt, last_upd_dt, password_expire_dt, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{password}, #{typeCd}, ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{memberName},'UTF8'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), #{nickname}, ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{phone},'UTF8'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{email},'UTF8'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), #{genderCd}, ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{birth},'UTF8'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{statusCd}, ''), 'STATUS01'), 'Y', 0, NOW(), NOW() + (COALESCE((SELECT password_expire_days FROM config LIMIT 1), 90) * INTERVAL '1 day'), #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp} )
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET type_cd = #{typeCd}, gender_cd = #{genderCd}, status_cd = #{statusCd}, name = ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{memberName},'UTF8'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), phone = ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{phone},'UTF8'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), email = ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{email},'UTF8'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), birth = ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{birth},'UTF8'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE member_id = #{rowId}
UPDATE member SET nickname = #{nickname}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE member_id = #{rowId}
UPDATE member SET profile_file_id = #{profileFileId}::integer, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE member_id = #{rowId}
UPDATE member SET last_login_dt = NOW(), last_login_ip = #{lastLoginIp}, fail_cnt = 0 WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

UPDATE member SET fail_cnt = fail_cnt + 1, status_cd = CASE WHEN fail_cnt + 1 >= (SELECT fail_cnt_limit FROM config LIMIT 1) THEN 'STATUS02' ELSE status_cd END, lock_until_dt = CASE WHEN fail_cnt + 1 >= (SELECT fail_cnt_limit FROM config LIMIT 1) THEN NOW() ELSE lock_until_dt END WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET status_cd = 'STATUS01', fail_cnt = 0, lock_until_dt = NULL WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, type_cd, nickname, handle, profile_file_id, use_yn FROM member WHERE handle = #{handle} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE member_id = #{rowId}
mapper.select: SELECT auth_group_id FROM auth_member WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_member (member_id, auth_group_id, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{authGroupId}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
